notes: LORE.md 5, #17. Off the first rescued ensign's own recorder, handed
to the ship on that rescue. ROADMAP2 1.7 wanted a reward that is not
another crystal. The ensigns are random names, so this one has
none: it is whoever was lying there, which is the point.
title: Unlabelled recording
subtitle: Off a Starfleet personal recorder, dubbed to tape
author: an ensign of the Adirondack's survey detachment
extra: Handed over in quarantine. Dubbed by Lt. Shepard.

lines.text: PERSONAL RECORDER. NO LABEL.
They handed me this in quarantine. They wanted you to have it.
A ceiling. The camera is on somebody's chest.
Okay. Okay. Recording. Hi.
I'm in a... it's a laundromat. I think it's a laundromat.
I'm on the floor. I'm fine. That's a lie. I'm mostly fine.
The breathing is wrong. Short, and it catches.
My leg is cut. Not bitten. I checked. I checked twice.
I've set the beacon. Nobody's answered it. That's fine.
I don't know if anybody's coming. I'm sorry. I'm just...
Sorry. I don't know why I'm apologising. To who.
Field dressing. Okay. Talk through it. Talk through it.
Pressure first. Above the wound. Something tight.
Belt. I've got a belt. Nobody tell the quartermaster.
Clean it if you can. I can't. There's bleach in here.
Don't use bleach. That's a joke. I'm making jokes.
Cover it. Wrap it. Not so tight your foot goes cold.
A long pause. Something outside the window, walking.
They walk past. They don't stop. I think they can't see me.
I'm very still. I'm very, very still.
If you find this and I'm... if I'm not...
Tell Lieutenant Shepard it was worth it. The work.
It's not true. Tell her anyway. She'd want it to be.
A chirp. Faint. From a long way off. A shuttle's hail.
Oh. Oh. That's... somebody's there. Somebody heard.
Okay. Stopping. I have to be quiet now. Okay.
RECORDING ENDS
They came up. They're in quarantine now. Thank you.
